messages:
elaine: Quick sync — prospect 'OrionEdge' wants a mixed workload POC (chat + embeddings) next week. They care about 99.9th tail latency under 300ms for chat at 60 qps and embeddings throughput of ~1200 reqs/min. Can we run a multi-region sweep and capture cold-starts?

samir: Yep. Curious about their input shapes — are chats short (<=128 tokens) and embeddings 512-d? need that for model/quant recommendations.

maya: I already asked for sample traffic profile. They said: chat avg 90 tokens, 95th 250 tokens; embedding payloads avg 512 bytes (text), concurrency spiky at 200 for a few minutes. Also they want a cost estimate for sustained 60 qps vs burst to 200 qps.

jack: Ops checklist: we'll run in us-west1 + eu-west1. Need service account from their side to run agent, or we can orchestrate from our dedicated env. Also need to confirm TLS and KMS workflow for Private deploys if they test on-prem.

vivian: Add security questionnaire Qs: data residency for embeddings, retention window, and whether we log input text. They'll require an entry in SOC21 workbook.

elaine: Plan suggestion: 1) smoke run (10m) to validate correctness 2) steady-state baseline (30m) at 60 qps 3) spike test: ramp to 200 qps for 5m 4) cold-start churn: cycle 20 instances to provoke cold KV cache. Collect lat p50/p95/p99 and token throughput.

samir: For model pick: recommend rdx-3b-chat-q8 for chat and rdx-embed-1 for embeddings. rdx-3b-chat-q8 gives much lower mem and acceptable quality for their prompt set. I'll prepare quantization/latency matrix.

maya: Can someone draft the curl+wrk commands for QA? ops-bot, can you post the runbook snippet?

ops-bot: runbook snippet: ```bash
# chats
wrk -t12 -c60 -d00:30s --latency \ 
  --script=chat.lua -- <PROXY_URL>/v1/chat --data '{"model":"rdx-3b-chat-q8","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<sample>"}] }'
# embeddings
wrk -t8 -c200 -d00:05s --latency \ 
  --script=embed.lua -- <PROXY_URL>/v1/embeddings --data '{"model":"rdx-embed-1","input":"<sample_text>"}'
```

jack: Also add header X-Redwood-Debug to collect KV cache hit rates. We'll capture trace ids for tail analysis.

elaine: Timing — can we run Thurs 09:00 PT? prospect prefers morning. Maya, I'll ask them to approve the run and share a sample dataset.

maya: Thumbs up, I'll confirm Thurs 09:00 PT and ask for SLA/contract stakeouts. Also requesting their security contact for the questionnaire.

samir: Quick note on metrics we need to report: p50/p95/p99 latency for request and per-token, token/sec, succ rate (HTTP 2xx), cold-start count, kv-cache hit ratio, GPU utilization.

vivian: Pricing ask: they want two numbers: (A) hosted cost estimate for steady 60 qps and (B) committed Dedicated pool price for baseline + burst headroom (200 qps) with 99.9% tail SLA. I'll collate with finance afterwards.

maya: For (A) I'll run a quick estimator after the smoke baseline and post a per-million token estimate. For (B) need expected sustained hours per month at baseline and number of burst hours.

elaine: Risk notes: If embeddings are PII, we need to toggle no-retention mode and add contract clause. Flagging legal.

samir: I'll run small internal sim now to sanity-check expected p99 at 60 qps on rdx-3b-chat-q8 and share results in this thread before Thurs.

jack: One more: network egress for eu-west1 to their EU office — confirm peering or VPN. Otherwise cross-region will skew latency.

maya: Got it. I'll collect sample traffic, security contact, and expected burst window breakdown. Will post confirmation and attach dataset link.

elaine: Perfect. Thanks team — please drop short updates here. :thumbsup:
